items.raw_excerpt: A 100-year-old insurance agent in South Korea still reports to her branch office every day and signs new contracts, 43 years after joining the company.
items.summary_en: A 100-year-old insurance agent in South Korea still goes to her branch office every day. She joined the company 43 years ago and still signs new contracts.
items.summary_ko: 한국에 100살 보험 영업사가 있다. 43년 전 입사해 지금까지도 매일 지점으로 출근해 새로운 보험 계약을 맺는다.
items.title_en: A 100-year-old grandmother in South Korea still goes to her office every day to sell insurance
items.title_ko: 100살 할머니가 매일 사무실 출근하며 보험을 판다
items.title_original: 100-year-old South Korean grandmother still commutes to work every day to sell insurance

items.raw_excerpt: At least three Gogoro battery-swap stations have been installed in Ho Chi Minh City over the past week as the Taiwanese company prepares to sell electric scooters in Vietnam.
items.summary_en: A Taiwanese electric scooter company has set up at least three battery swap stations in Ho Chi Minh City in one week. The company plans to start selling electric scooters in Vietnam soon. Riders can change a flat battery at a swap station instead of waiting to charge.
items.summary_ko: 대만 전기 스쿠터 기업이 최근 일주일 동안 호치민시에 배터리 교환소를 최소 세 곳 설치했습니다. 이 업체는 곧 베트남에서 전기 스쿠터 판매를 시작할 계획입니다. 교환소를 이용하면 배터리를 기다리는 대신 바로 갈아탈 수 있습니다.
items.title_en: Taiwan e-scooter maker puts battery swap spots in Ho Chi Minh City
items.title_ko: 대만 전기 스쿠터 기업, 호치민시에 배터리 교환소 설치
items.title_original: Taiwan's largest e-scooter maker sets up battery-swap stations in Vietnam

items.raw_excerpt: It was meant to be a celebration of Fremantle's moment in the grand final sun, but their viral Wharfie Time backfired spectacularly on Saturday.
items.summary_en: Fremantle fans made a funny tradition called Wharfie Time before the AFL Grand Final. They jumped off their seats, but the joke went wrong when the team lost. Many fans fell off chairs, and some are now calling the moment a lesson in hubris.
items.summary_ko: AFL 그랜드 파이널 전, 프레민틀 팬들이 만든 웃긴 전통이 '워파이 타임'이다. 이 관습은 좌석에서 벌떡 뛰는 것으로 끝났고, 팀이 패배하자 누구도 모르게 장난이 사고로 바뀌었다. 부딪혀 다친 팬도 나오며, 팬들은 이 일을 교훈으로 여기고 있다.
items.title_en: What Is Wharfie Time and Why Did It Backfire for Fremantle Fans?
items.title_ko: '워파이 타임이란', 프레민틀 팬들을 어떻게 울린 것인가
items.title_original: What is Wharfie Time and how did it backfire for heartbroken Dockers?
